name: Digits
short_description: AI bookkeeping platform that categorizes, reconciles and closes books continuously.
notes: Pro plan listed as 'coming soon'. No per-seat fees; multi-entity needs separate subscriptions. 30-day trial. Developer API & MCP advertised on pricing page.

name: Vic.ai
short_description: Autonomous accounts-payable platform with AI agents for invoice processing, approvals and payments.
notes: No public prices; demo request only. Products: VicInbox, VicPay, VicCard, VicAnalytics, VicAgents.

name: Ramp
short_description: Spend management platform with AI agents for expense review, AP coding and approvals.
notes: Plus is $15/user/month plus a platform fee based on team size (not published); 20% off annual. Procurement is an add-on. MCP documented at support.ramp.com/ramp-mcp. Travel Booking capability based on Ramp Travel product (not on pricing page) - verify.

name: Brex
short_description: Corporate card and spend platform with an AI expense assistant and automated bill pay.
notes: AI features: AI expense assistant, auto-filled expense reports, AI compliance audit (Premium+). Agentic depth lighter than dedicated AP agents. Premium billing interval (monthly vs annual) not stated.

name: Booke AI
short_description: AI bookkeeper for QuickBooks and Xero that categorizes and reconciles transactions.
notes: $129 per business/month; monthly/annual toggle shown but annual price not captured. Firm pricing by request. No public API documented.

name: Stampli
short_description: AP automation platform where its Billy AI agent captures, codes and matches invoices.
notes: Quote-based. Add-ons: Procurement, Direct Pay, Credit Card, Advanced Vendor Management.

name: Tipalti
short_description: Payables automation with AI agents for invoice scanning, bill approvals and reporting.
notes: Prices are 'starting at' plus per-invoice/per-payment transaction fees; custom quotes for exact pricing. Procurement, Expenses, Treasury add-ons.

name: Rillet
short_description: AI-native ERP and general ledger with Aura AI to automate accounting close.
notes: Quote-based via demo. API docs at docs.api.rillet.com. Agent capabilities of Aura AI not detailed on the page.

name: Hebbia
short_description: AI agent platform for investment professionals to analyze filings, data rooms and documents.
notes: No pricing page; demo request only. Products: Matrix and Max. Integrates SEC filings, FactSet, S&P Capital IQ, PitchBook.

name: AlphaSense
short_description: Market intelligence platform with generative search and workflow agents for financial research.
notes: Annual subscriptions, custom quotes. Homepage has 'Get Started for Free' CTA but no documented free plan/trial.

name: Rogo
short_description: AI agents for bankers and investors that produce models, memos and decks from financial data.
notes: rogo.ai redirects to rogo.com. No pricing page; demo only.

name: Zeni
short_description: AI bookkeeping and finance service for startups with AI bill pay and reimbursements.
notes: Listed prices are billed annually ($549/$799 per month list before 10% annual discount); monthly-billed availability unclear. Hybrid AI + human finance team. Add-ons: CFO, tax, payroll.

name: Docyt
short_description: AI accounting automation with agents for continuous close, reconciliation and reporting.
notes: $299/property/month is 'starting at', monthly billing on annual plans. Payments and BI suites add-on prices not listed. Claims 16 AI agents.

name: Puzzle
short_description: AI-powered accounting software that auto-categorizes transactions and drafts financial statements.
notes: Free trial mentioned. Monthly/yearly toggle; whether shown prices are monthly-billed not confirmed. AI credits vary by plan.

name: Datarails
short_description: Excel-native FP&A platform with AI agents for recurring analyses and board-ready reports.
notes: All tiers quote-based. 'FinanceOS AI Connector' exposes data to external AI tools (protocol not specified).

name: Numeric
short_description: AI-powered close management and financial data platform with agentic reconciliation and analysis.
notes: Custom pricing based on transactions and seats. In-app AI 'Prism'.

name: FinRobot
short_description: Open-source multi-agent framework that generates equity research reports and valuations.
notes: Apache-2.0, ~7.8k stars. Requires own LLM API keys. Desktop v0.1.0 for macOS.

name: Basis
short_description: AI agents for accounting firms that run closes, tax prep and audit procedures end-to-end.
notes: No pricing page; demo/waitlist signup. Targets accounting firms.

name: Abacum
short_description: AI-native FP&A platform for forecasting, scenario planning and automated performance summaries.
notes: Quote-based via demo. Pricing URL content resembled homepage; no prices published.

name: OpenBB Workspace
short_description: Financial research workspace with an AI copilot and custom agents over market data.
notes: Lite $1,200/yr shown as 50% promo 'until Aug 31' (may be stale). Open Data Platform is open source; Workspace is proprietary with announced plans to open-source -> open_source null. Community: 20 Copilot queries/day. Workspace MCP server.

name: Superhuman Mail
short_description: AI email client that auto-drafts replies, labels, archives and reminds you to follow up.
notes: Mail only in Business/Enterprise tiers of Superhuman Suite; $33/mo if billed annually. Free/Pro suite tiers exclude Mail. 'Mail MCP' listed.

name: Shortwave
short_description: Gmail client with an AI assistant that searches, drafts, filters and organizes your inbox.
notes: Monthly billing prices. 14-day trial. Permanent free tier not confirmed.

name: Fyxer AI
short_description: AI executive assistant that sorts your inbox, drafts replies and writes meeting follow-ups.
notes: Page showed $37/$64 per month billed annually vs $49/$99 standard; recorded $49/$99 as monthly - verify. Credit-based (Free 400/mo). API on Enterprise only.

name: Lindy
short_description: AI assistant that manages inbox, calendar, meeting notes and tasks through Slack or iMessage.
notes: Credit-based (3k/15k/35k credits/user/month). 7-day trial only for teammates joining via Slack; direct signups billed immediately.

name: Inbox Zero
short_description: Open-source AI email assistant that sorts, labels, drafts replies and blocks cold email.
notes: Up to 20% off annual. Self-hostable open-source repo. 7-day trial on Starter.

name: Motion
short_description: AI calendar and project manager that auto-schedules tasks and meetings into your day.
notes: Listed as monthly-billing prices; annual saves 33% (unusually low monthly - verify). Credits: 7.5k/15k per seat; extra credits $0.25/$0.19 per 100.

name: Reclaim.ai
short_description: AI calendar assistant that auto-schedules focus time, habits, tasks and meetings.
notes: Extracted page listed $10/$15 and $12/$18 with monthly/annual labels apparently swapped; recorded higher figures as monthly-billed - verify. Enterprise $22 annual only, contact sales. Recommended by Clockwise as migration path.

name: Howie
short_description: AI calendar secretary that schedules meetings over email, SMS and iMessage.
notes: Team includes 1,250 credits/month, unlimited teammates; custom assistant email +$20/month. Free starter credits ($25 value) recorded as free_trial. /pricing returned 404; prices taken from homepage.

name: Otter.ai
short_description: AI meeting agent that transcribes, summarizes and answers questions across meetings.
notes: Annual: Pro $8.33, Business $19.99 /user/month. API & MCP server on Enterprise. 'SDR Agent' for lead qualification mapped to Lead Scoring.

name: Fireflies.ai
short_description: AI notetaker that records, transcribes and summarizes meetings with an assistant, AskFred.
notes: Annual: Pro $10, Business $19. Enterprise $39/seat/month annual only. Voice Agents / Email Assistant on higher tiers.

name: Fathom
short_description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes calls and syncs to CRM.
notes: Annual: Premium $16, Team $15, Business $25. Team plans min 2 users. 90-day money-back guarantee.

name: Granola
short_description: Bot-free AI notepad that transcribes meetings and turns notes into summaries and follow-ups.
notes: Page did not distinguish monthly vs annual billing for listed prices. MCP & API on Business+.

name: Read AI
short_description: AI meeting copilot that summarizes meetings and searches across meetings, email and chat.
notes: Annual: $15 / $22.50 / $29.75. Enterprise+ requires 5+ licenses.

name: Jamie
short_description: Bot-free AI note-taker that summarizes online and in-person meetings, hosted in the EU.
notes: Plus/Pro prices are billed annually; monthly-billed prices not captured. Team billing basis unclear. Translation inferred from 99+ language support - verify.

name: MeetGeek
short_description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and runs agentic follow-up workflows.
notes: Unclear whether listed prices are monthly or annual-billed (annual saves up to 40%). 14-day trial on Business. Custom Voice Agents on Enterprise.

name: Martin
short_description: AI personal assistant that manages calendar, inbox, reminders and calls via text or voice.
notes: Annual: $21 / $30 per month. 7-day free trial. Homepage showed stale Black Friday banner. free_plan false inferred from no free tier listed.

name: Notion Agent
short_description: Workspace AI agent that runs multi-step tasks, takes meeting notes and researches across apps.
notes: Annual: Plus $8, Business $16. Free has only basic AI trial. Custom Agents $10 per 1,000 monthly credits after trial. MCP not on pricing page (null).

name: Akiflow
short_description: Task and calendar planner with an AI assistant, Aki, that organizes and schedules your work.
notes: 7-day trial, card required. Multi-year 'Believer' plans also offered. Teams custom pricing.

name: Cal.com
short_description: Open-source scheduling platform with Cal.ai voice agents that book meetings by phone.
notes: Teams/Organizations prices shown are annual-billed (25% savings); monthly-billed prices not captured. Cal.ai voice agent pricing not on page.

name: Saner.AI
short_description: AI personal assistant for notes, tasks and schedules that plans your day from your data.
notes: 20% off annual. Unclear whether listed prices are monthly-billed. External model usage billed separately by tokens. Calendar/task features not described on pricing page, so not mapped.
